# ----- CHECK BASELINE DIFFERENCES -----

```{r baseline-t-tests}

# Alertness
alertness_base_ot <- data_eo$Alertness_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 1 & data_eo$TP == 1]
alertness_base_pl <- data_eo$Alertness_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 2 & data_eo$TP == 1]
# Excitement
excitement_base_ot <- data_eo$Excitement_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 1 & data_eo$TP == 1]
excitement_base_pl <- data_eo$Excitement_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 2 & data_eo$TP == 1]
# Sociability
sociability_base_ot <- data_eo$Sociability_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 1 & data_eo$TP == 1]
sociability_base_pl <- data_eo$Sociability_base_reversed[data_eo$Drug == 2 & data_eo$TP == 1]

# ttests
alertness_baseline_t = t.test(alertness_base_ot, alertness_base_pl, paired = TRUE)
print("ALERTNESS")
print(alertness_baseline_t)

excitement_baseline_t = t.test(excitement_base_ot, excitement_base_pl, paired = TRUE)
print("EXCITEMENT")
print(excitement_baseline_t)

sociability_baseline_t = t.test(sociability_base_ot, sociability_base_pl, paired = TRUE)
print("SOCIABILITY")
print(sociability_baseline_t)
```

```{r behav-plot}

# Save path
plotsavepath <- paste0("//Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/NEW_plots/behavplots", whichpower, "/")

plot_slopes <- function(model, data, band, whichpower, whicheyes, mental_state) {

  # Generate x-axis values
  x_values <- seq(
    min(data[[mental_state]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data[[mental_state]], na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )

  # Explicitly specify all timepoints for equal averaging
  tp_values <- unique(data$TP[!is.na(data$TP)])

  # Estimated marginal means across mental-state ratings,
  # averaged equally over timepoints
  at_values <- list()
  at_values[[mental_state]] <- x_values
  at_values[["TP"]] <- tp_values

  emm <- emmeans(
    model,
    specs = as.formula(paste("~ Drug |", mental_state)),
    at = at_values,
    weights = "equal"
  )
  

  # Extract predictions and confidence intervals
  plot_df <- as.data.frame(
    summary(emm, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  ) %>%
    rename(x = all_of(mental_state))
  
  # Axis labels
  y_label <- paste(
    band,
    ifelse(whichpower == "rel", "Relative", "Absolute"),
    "power,",
    ifelse(whicheyes == "eyes_open", "eyes open", "eyes closed")
  )

  x_label <- gsub("_reversed", "", mental_state)

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = x, y = emmean, color = Drug, linetype = Drug)
  ) +
    

    # 95% confidence intervals
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = Drug),
      alpha = 0.18,
      color = NA
    ) +

    # Estimated marginal slopes
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red"),
      labels = c("1" = "Oxytocin", "2" = "Placebo")
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red")
    ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("1" = "solid", "2" = "dotted"),
      labels = c("1" = "Oxytocin", "2" = "Placebo")
    ) +
    

labs(
  x = x_label,
  y = y_label,
  color = "Drug",
  linetype = "Drug",
  fill = "Drug"
) +
    

    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
      
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 17),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 17)
    )

  return(p)
}
```

# func to organize outputs

```{r outputs}

print_anova_results <- function(anova_table) {

  df <- as.data.frame(anova_table)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {

    effect <- rownames(df)[i]

    # Clean variable names
    effect <- gsub("_reversed", "", effect)
    effect <- gsub("_base", " (baseline)", effect)

    df1 <- df$NumDF[i]
    df2 <- df$DenDF[i]
    F_value <- df[["F value"]][i]
    p <- df[["Pr(>F)"]][i]

    # Significance symbols
    stars <- if (p < .001) "***" else if (p < .01) "**" else if (p < .05) "*" else if (p < .10) "†" else ""

    # Format p-value
    p_text <- if (p < .001) "< .001" else sprintf("= %.3f", p)

    cat(sprintf(
      "%s: F(%.0f, %.2f) = %.2f, p %s%s\n",
      effect, df1, df2, F_value, p_text, stars
    ))
  }
}

print_trend_results <- function(trends_df) {

  # Identify slope estimate column
  trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(trends_df), value = TRUE)

  for (i in 1:nrow(trends_df)) {

    drug_name <- ifelse(trends_df$Drug[i] == 1, "Oxytocin", "Placebo")

    cat(sprintf(
      "%s: β = %.4f, SE = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f], t(%.2f) = %.3f, p = %.4f\n",
      drug_name,
      trends_df[[trend_col]][i],
      trends_df$SE[i],
      trends_df$lower.CL[i],
      trends_df$upper.CL[i],
      trends_df$df[i],
      trends_df$t.ratio[i],
      trends_df$p.value[i]
    ))
  }
}

print_trend_results_tp <- function(trends_df) {

  # Check whether TP is present
  has_tp <- "TP" %in% names(trends_df)

  # Split by timepoint if applicable
  if (has_tp) {
    tp_groups <- split(trends_df, trends_df$TP)

    for (tp in names(tp_groups)) {
      cat("\nTP =", tp, ":\n")

      df <- tp_groups[[tp]]
      df$r_equiv <- with(df,t.ratio / sqrt(t.ratio^2 + df))
      
      trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(df), value = TRUE)

      for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
        drug_name <- ifelse(df$Drug[i] == 1, "Oxytocin", "Placebo")
  
      cat(sprintf(
        "%s: β = %.4f, SE = %.4f, 95%% CI [%.4f, %.4f], t(%.2f) = %.3f, p = %.4f\n",
        drug_name,
        df[[trend_col]][i],
        df$SE[i],
        df$lower.CL[i],
        df$upper.CL[i],
        df$df[i],
        df$t.ratio[i],
        df$p.value[i]
      ))
      }
    }

  } else {

    for (i in 1:nrow(trends_df)) {
      drug_name <- ifelse(trends_df$Drug[i] == 1, "Oxytocin", "Placebo")

      cat(sprintf(
        "%s (Drug %s): t(%.3f) = %.3f, d = %.3f, p = %.3f\n",
        drug_name,
        trends_df$Drug[i],
        trends_df$df[i],
        trends_df$t.ratio[i],
        trends_df$d[i],
        trends_df$p.value[i]
      ))
    }
  }
}
```

# ----> Loop through eyes cond, bands, scales <-----
# --> Run LMMs iteratively, then slopes, then tp <--
# ----------------> also, plot <--------------------

```{r omnibus, echo=FALSE}

omnibus_found <- list()

path_to_savefile = paste0("//Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/NEW_results/result_BEHAV_FINAL_", whichpower, ".txt")
sink(path_to_savefile)

# LOOP THROUGH EYE OPEN/CLOSED
for (eyes_cond in c("eyes_open", "eyes_closed")){
  
  # chose the right data depending on eyes cond
  if (eyes_cond == "eyes_open") {mydata_main <- data_eo} else {mydata_main   <- data_ec} 
  if (eyes_cond == "eyes_open") {printeyes <- "Eyes open"} else {printeyes <- "Eyes closed"} 
  
  cat("\n\n", printeyes, ":\n\n")

  # LOOP THROUGH BEHAV MEASURES
  behav_vars <- c("Alertness_reversed", "Excitement_reversed", "Sociability_reversed")
  
  for (behav_var in behav_vars) { 
  printbehav <- gsub("_reversed", "", behav_var)

    # LOOP THROUGH BANDS
    bands <- c("Theta", "Alpha", "Beta")
    for (band in bands) {
      
      # do the analysis for this eyes condition, band, measure
      
      cat(paste0("\n\n", printeyes, ": ", printbehav, ", ", band, "\n"))
      
      formula_str <- paste0(band, " ~ ", band, "_base + TP*Drug*", behav_var, " + (1|id)")
      # save formula in output txt
      #cat("\n\n")
      #cat(formula_str)
      #cat("\n\n")
      
      modelfull <- lmer(as.formula(formula_str),data = mydata_main,control = lmerControl(
        optimizer = "bobyqa",optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))
      #print(modelfull)
      anovafull <- anova(modelfull, type=3)
      
      cat("\n\nOmnibus results from ANOVA:\n\n")
      print_anova_results(anovafull)
      
      # if anova shows significant main or interaction --> update list of significant results
      
      effectsomn <- c(behav_var, paste0("TP:", behav_var), paste0("Drug:", behav_var), paste0("TP:Drug:", behav_var))      
      for (effect in effectsomn) {
        if (anovafull[effect, "Pr(>F)"] < 0.05) {omnibus_found <- c(omnibus_found,sprintf(
              "%s: %s, %s --> signif: %s -- %s",
              eyes_cond, band, behav_var, effect, anovafull[effect, "Pr(>F)"]))}}

    
      #cat("\n===== SLOPE ESTIMATIONS from the main model =====\n")
      #cat("\n=== --> SLOPES overall, across timepoints <-- ===\n\n")

      # --> step2: slopes from model
      trendsfull <- emtrends(modelfull,~ Drug,var = behav_var)
      trendsfull_df <- as.data.frame(summary(trendsfull, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
      #trendsfull_df$d <- t_to_d(trendsfull_df$t.ratio, trendsfull_df$df)
      trendsfull_df$d <- as.data.frame(effectsize::t_to_d(t = trendsfull_df$t.ratio,df_error = trendsfull_df$df))$d
      #print(trendsfull_df)
      cat("\nOverall slopes estimation, for oxytocin and placebo:\n\n")
      print_trend_results(trendsfull_df)
      
      # plot these slopes
      #p <- plot_slopes(model=modelfull,data=mydata_main,band = band, whichpower = whichpower,whicheyes = eyes_cond,mental_state = behav_var)
      #ggsave(paste0(plotsavepath, "plot_", whichpower, "_", band, "_", behav_var, "_", eyes_cond, ".png"),plot = p,width = 6,height = 5,units = "in",dpi = 300)

      #cat("\n=== --> SLOPES at each timepoint <-- ===\n\n")
      # --> step3: by timepoint
      trendstp <- emtrends(modelfull,~ Drug | TP,var = behav_var)
      trendstp_df <- as.data.frame(summary(trendstp, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
      #trendstp_df$d <- t_to_d(trendstp_df$t.ratio, trendstp_df$df)
      trendstp_df$d <- as.data.frame(effectsize::t_to_d(trendstp_df$t.ratio,trendstp_df$df))$d
      #print(trendstp_df)
      cat("\nSlopes estimation by timepoint, for oxytocin and placebo:\n")
      print_trend_results_tp(trendstp_df)

      }}}
      

cat("\n=========================================================\n\n")
cat("===== Omnibus significat results found: =====\n\n")
cat("=========================================================\n\n")
print(omnibus_found)
cat("=========================================================\n\n")
```
